OTEL compatible
Drop in our sdk or point your existing Open Telemetry pipeline at Latitude and traces show up. No proprietary format, no lock-in.
View docs ->
Custom signals
Define a signal for any behavior you want to track — a failure mode, policy, or quality check — and Latitude detects it on every matching session.
View docs ->
Dataset management
Golden datasets built automatically from validated production traces. One per issue, versioned, ready to run evals or regression tests against.
View docs ->
Human annotations
Leave inline feedback on any trace, span, or output. Your team's judgment becomes structured signal you can search, cluster, and turn into evals.
View docs ->
Advanced filters
Semantic search, exact text, and metadata filters combined. Find cohorts like "frustrated users on GPT-5.5 in prod after the May release" without writing queries.
View docs ->
Failure mode clustering
Similar failing traces get grouped into a single issue with examples, trend, affected users, and lifecycle. You triage patterns, not individual logs.
View docs ->
